name: Mystery Adept
text:
Your greatest ambition is to enroll in Absalom's prestigious College of Mysteries, one of the most highly regarded institutions of magical training in the world. The admission standards are stringent, but you are ready to do what must be done to add your name to their ledger of students, which has meant spending excruciating hours studying and training.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Arcana skill and in the Academia Lore skill. You gain the Arcane Sense skill feat.
